_source: stratagems grouped by DETACHMENT. PRIMARY = faction pack (_src=faction-pack); FALLBACK = 39k.pro JS bundle via pull_39k.py (_src=39k.pro) for strats/detachments the pack omits.

Blessings of Filth.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Blessings of Filth.target: One **DEATH GUARD** Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Blessings of Filth.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Blessings of Filth.lore: Employing their unique gifts, this champion enhances the weapons of their comrades with even greater levels of infectious malevolence.

Grotesque Fortitude.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Grotesque Fortitude.target: One **DEATH GUARD** Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Grotesque Fortitude.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
Grotesque Fortitude.lore: After their champion calls down the blessings of Nurgle, these warriors can fight on no matter the catastrophic, often gruesome, damage done to them by the foe.

Malignance Magnified.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Malignance Magnified.target: One **DEATH GUARD** Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Malignance Magnified.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Malignance Magnified.lore: The vile talents of such plague specialists act like a filth-smeared lens, focusing and intensifying the infectious gifts of Nurgle.

Rabid Infusion.target: One **DEATH GUARD** unit from your army that includes two **CHARACTER** models.
Rabid Infusion.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
Rabid Infusion.lore: The combined talents of these Death Guard champions drive their followers into a foam-jawed fury, be it through injection with a curdled cocktail of stimms or immersion in a fug of infectious agents.

Bloodrust Deluge.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to shoot.
Bloodrust Deluge.effect: Select one visible enemy unit. That enemy unit is Afflicted until your unit has attacked.

Fresh Vectors.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to attack.
Fresh Vectors.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re‑roll wound rolls of 1.

Soulrot Flux.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall‑back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
Soulrot Flux.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall‑back move, roll one D6: ▪ On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. ▪ On a 2‑5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. ▪ On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. UNIQUE: FLYBLOWN FLYBLOWN HOST PLAGUE MARINES ADVANCE INEXORABLY AMIDST A THRUMMING DETACHMENT RULES VERMINOUS HAZE A cloud of winged insects descends over Mortarion’s pathogenic sons, obscuring their malodorous ranks and shielding them from the eyes and augurs of the enemy. Beneath thrumming storms of fat‑bodied flies, Plague Marines stride towards their wavering foes until they are close enough to unleash punishing volleys of killing fire. In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to two friendly PLAGUE MARINES units. Those units have Infiltrators. This detachment has the FLYBLOWN tag and cannot be taken with another FLYBLOWN detachment. ENHANCEMENTS INSECTILE MURMURATION UPGRADE The buzzing swarms respond to the will of Nurgle’s disciples, sweeping down upon their chosen target, their crawling, biting and droning enfeebling the horrified foe. PLAGUE MARINES unit only. When this unit’s attacks target a unit within Contagion Range of a friendly unit, those attacks can re‑roll wound rolls of 1. PLAGUEVEIL UPGRADE Nurgle’s blessings manifest as a buzzing clot of darkness that falls over these diseased pilgrims, enveloping them like an enshrouding fog. PLAGUE MARINES unit only. This unit has -3" detection range. HAZE OF SWOLLEN DAEMON FLIES

Droning Horror.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.
Droning Horror.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks: ▪ Can re‑roll hit rolls of 1. ▪ That target a unit within half range, can re‑roll wound rolls of 1.

Eye of the Swarm.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.
Eye of the Swarm.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [CLOSE‑QUARTERS]. PARAGONS OF THE CHAMPIONS OF THE DEATH GUARD RADIATE THE MOST DETACHMENT RULES HYPERVIRULENT STRAINS The rancid champions of the Death Guard are blessed with the most virulent contagions of Nurgle, supernatural strains that radiate towards unwilling hosts in floods of foulness. Friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER units have +3" to their Contagion Range (to a maximum of 12"). ENHANCEMENTS REJUVENATING SWARM With a hacking prayer to Nurgle, this warrior can call upon a swarm of plague mites. Buzzing clumps of diseased flies and writhing waves of squirming things settle upon the bloated forms of the Death Guard and vomit streams of rejuvenating contagion into festering wounds. DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only (excluding TERMINATOR models). Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls. HOST OF THE HYBRIDISED POX One plague is never enough for this champion, and their repulsive form is a vessel for a mutated and semisentient disease capable of manifesting in varied contagious forms. DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle’s Gift (see Codex: Death Guard). Enemy units within Contagion Range of this unit also have the effect of that Plague in addition to your army’s chosen Plague until the end of the battle. PUTRESCENCE LETHAL OF CONTAGIONS

Nauseating Paroxysms.target: One friendly engaged PLAGUE MARINES unit.
Nauseating Paroxysms.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle‑shock roll, with -1 to that battle‑shock roll.

Drawn to Despair.target: One **DEATH GUARD** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Drawn to Despair.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding **AIRCRAFT**) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Drawn to Despair.lore: Those who languish in misery or cower in terror make themselves easy targets for the Death Guard.

Eyestinger Storm.target: One **DEATH GUARD VEHICLE** unit from your army.
Eyestinger Storm.effect: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
Eyestinger Storm.lore: Swarms of these revolting insects burrow hives into the hulls of Death Guard vehicles. Drawn to sickened prey, they boil forth in buzzing masses and descend on the foe, spreading panic and horror.

Font of Filth.target: One **DEATH GUARD VEHICLE** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Font of Filth.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.
Font of Filth.lore: As though afflicted with some awful vomiting sickness, this vehicle’s weapons retch an endless stream of fire at the enemy, heaving themselves empty even as it storms into the enemy lines.

Relentless Grind.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Relentless Grind.target: One **DEATH GUARD VEHICLE** unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Relentless Grind.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
Relentless Grind.lore: When the armoured vehicles of the Death Guard advance, they plough through - or straight over- anything that stands in their way.

Stinking Mire.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Stinking Mire.target: One **DEATH GUARD VEHICLE** unit from your army.
Stinking Mire.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as the target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
Stinking Mire.lore: Attempting to counterattack Death Guard can leave foes floundering amidst bubbling filth.

Aggravus Spasms.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
Aggravus Spasms.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within Contagion Range of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

Simultaneous Contamination.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit starts an action.
Simultaneous Contamination.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot. Barrage of Filth: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover. FACTION KEYWORDS: Death Guard DEFILER Huge Daemon Engines dripping with corruption, the Defilers used by the Death Guard are horrifically powerful whether bombarding the foe from range with grotesquely diseased projectiles or tearing them apart at close quarters with piston-driven claws of rusted metal etched with cursed runes of corrosion. Territorial Infection.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
Territorial Infection.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

Gnawing Hunger.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Gnawing Hunger.lore: Gripped by a sudden, monstrous hunger, the Poxwalkers surge forward in a ravenous mass.

Grip of the Walking Pox.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Grip of the Walking Pox.target: One **POXWALKERS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Grip of the Walking Pox.effect: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.
Grip of the Walking Pox.lore: Those infected by walking pox may fall as though fatally wounded, but they soon rise again.

Hidden Amongst The Dead.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
Hidden Amongst The Dead.target: One **POXWALKERS** unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
Hidden Amongst The Dead.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.
Hidden Amongst The Dead.lore: Another wave of Poxwalkers rises from the battlefield’s carrion heaps.

Shock and Horror.when: Your Charge phase, just after a **DEATH GUARD** unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Shock and Horror.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
Shock and Horror.lore: Already dismayed by this living nightmare, the enemy falters before another sudden onslaught.

Smeared With Filth.target: One **POXWALKERS** unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
Smeared With Filth.effect: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
Smeared With Filth.lore: Hacking a path through a horde of Poxwalkers leaves aggressors coated in infectious matter.

Creeping Blight.target: One **DEATH GUARD INFANTRY** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Creeping Blight.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Creeping Blight.lore: Those in the grip of Nurgle’s unholy plagues become weaker by the moment, barely able to lift their weapons, let alone defend themselves from the attacking Death Guard.

Disgustingly Resilient.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Disgustingly Resilient.target: One **DEATH GUARD** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Disgustingly Resilient.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Disgustingly Resilient.lore: Those favoured by Nurgle are inured to pain, their rotting bodies shrugging off all but the most traumatic damage with ease.

Overwhelming Generosity.target: One **DEATH GUARD CHARACTER** unit from your army.
Overwhelming Generosity.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a **DEATH GUARD** unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
Overwhelming Generosity.lore: Unholy filth gushes from Nurgle’s faithful into their guns until the armaments threaten to burst like bloated corpses.

Putrid Detonation.target: One **DEATH GUARD VEHICLE** or **DEATH GUARD MONSTER** model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Putrid Detonation.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
Putrid Detonation.lore: Bloated with putrefaction and swilling with infectious poisons, the demise of this hulking entity is as revolting as it is explosively hazardous.
